digest.component_or_area: pytest test harness / temporary fixture management
propositions: Nested pytest processes without explicit --basetemp allocate pytest's user-global numbered temp root and may delete unrelated cleanup-eligible directories at session finish.
Two executing nested pytest launchers (test_engine_dir.py and test_scripts_import_convention.py) joined the shared numbered root without private basetemp, deleting unrelated sentinel files.
Pytest 9.1.1 TempPathFactory.getbasetemp creates and registers numbered-root cleanup; pytest_sessionfinish skips cleanup only when _basetemp is None, enabling cross-session interference.
Parent process ownership of basetemp (tmp_path/child-name passed via --basetemp) ensures nested pytest cleanup remains local and prevents deletion of unrelated trees.
Three collect-only nested launchers and all pytester-managed launches are unaffected because they either never allocate TempPathFactory._basetemp or receive basetemp from their helper.
